verdicts.reason: Both use the same layout: the headline is stacked on top and the subhead and CTA share one row at the bottom. That row sits close to the bottom edge, and the italic 'Now in four flavours' is very small. A breaks the headline cleanly ('Bubbles, / botanicals / and a little / sunshine.').
